author: Ari Koslow
title: Teoscar Hernandez (hamstring) could begin rehab assignment next week
desc: Teoscar Hernandez could be cleared to begin a rehab assignment next week.
impact: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Hernandez will go on a rehab assignment when the team is on the road next. That starts on Monday against the Twins.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Edwin Diaz (elbow) throws 15 pitches in bullpen session Friday
desc: Edwin Diaz threw a successful 15-pitch bullpen session on Friday.
impact: Diaz threw off the mound for the first time since his surgery. He'll continue to throw bullpens until he is cleared to face live hitters.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Manuel Rodriguez (elbow) to throw live BP June 30
desc: Rays manager Kevin Cash said Manuel Rodriguez will throw his first live BP session on June 30.
impact: Rodriguez is working his way back from right elbow surgery. He should head on a rehab assignment in July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Edwin Uceta (shoulder) to resume throwing at end of June
desc: Rays manager Kevin Cash said Edwin Uceta will resume throwing in 10 days.
impact: Uceta is working his way back from a right shoulder injury. He should begin a rehab assignment in July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Lazaro Estrada (shoulder) to be activated from IL
desc: The Blue Jays are expected to activate Lazaro Estrada from the injured list.
impact: Estrada was transferred to the 60-day injured list at the end of May. He threw 12 1/3 innings on a rehab assignment with Triple-A Buffalo.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Will Smith (neck) will not return this weekend
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Will Smith will not be activated this weekend.
impact: Smith is going to have a cortisone injection in his neck. He could be activated at some point next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Mahle (hamstring) to return Wednesday
desc: Tyler Mahle will return from the injured list to start on Wednesday against the Athletics.
impact: Mahle concluded his rehab assignment this week. There should be an official roster move announced by Wednesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Marcelo Mayer (illness) not in lineup Friday
desc: Marcelo Mayer is not in the Red Sox lineup on Friday against the Mariners due to an illness.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Andrew Bash signs minor league deal with Athletics
desc: The Athletics signed Andrew Bash to a minor league contract.
impact: Bash was previously in the Twins organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Julio Rodriguez (hamstring) back in lineup Friday
desc: Julio Rodriguez is back in the Mariners lineup on Friday against the Red Sox.
impact: Rodriguez was removed earlier this week due to a spasm in his hamstring. He is back in center field and batting third.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Fernandez (back) begins rehab assignment Friday
desc: Ryan Fernandez began a rehab assignment on Friday.
impact: Fernandez was placed on the injured list back in the first week of June. He'll likely require a handful of rehab appearances before he is activated.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Corey Seager (concussion) will not be activated Friday
desc: The Rangers will not activate Corey Seager from the concussion injured list on Friday.
impact: Seager can be activated any day. He could be back this weekend or early next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Miles Mikolas to pitch in bulk relief role Friday
desc: Miles Mikolas will pitch in a bulk relief role on Friday against the Rays.
impact: Mikolas will take the mound behind PJ Poulin, who is opening for Washington.

author: Ari Koslow
title: LaMonte Wade Jr. (hamstring) 'really close' to being activated
desc: The Astros say LaMonte Wade Jr. is "really, really close to being activated."
impact: Wade is working out with the team on Friday. It appears he could be activated from the injured list as early as next week.
